subject: MAP / Eval Close: final go/no-go, signature timing, and day-one start
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@stellarsys.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@stellarsys.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation readout — need decision window

Jonas / Camila,

Thanks for the trial run last week — the eval went smoothly and our engineers ran the full conversational throughput scenarios against the sample dataset. I’ve attached the MAP we consolidated with timelines and the short SOW with the two items Legal asked to keep as placeholders.

High-level summary:
- Key eval outcome: latency and token accuracy are within our thresholds for the 90th percentile; a single regression on multi-turn reranking popped up (log attached).
- Ops ask: final go/no-go needs an exec stamp by next Thursday so Procurement can route the PO for the month-end invoice window.

Concrete asks from Stellar:
1) Can Redwood confirm an absolute start date if we sign by 2028-05-12? We are targeting 2028-06-01 for pilot start.
2) Who is the signer for the SOW on Redwood’s side — does Legal need to review the SOW redlines before routing?
3) Please confirm if the canary policy and fallback model variant are in the MAP (we noted section 4.2 but want it locked).

I’ll propose a time for an executive go/no-go call if helpful. Attached: Stellar_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP), SOW_redwood_draft.docx (SOW).

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director, Cloud Platform
Stellar Systems

---

- Stellar_MAP_v3.pdf (pdf)
- SOW_redwood_draft.docx (docx)

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@stellarsys.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation readout — need decision window

Samantha — great to hear the eval results. Short answers up front: yes, we can meet a 2028-06-01 start if we get an executed SOW and PO by 2028-05-12; signer will be our VP of Sales (Lauren) and Legal does want to review the redlines but there are only two optional clauses we typically accept as-is.

I outlined a minimal signoff runbook in the MAP and the path to lock:
- Today (5/9): finalize SOW redlines (Jonas/Camila) and publish MAP v3 (done, attached).
- 5/10: Legal quick-review (Lauren) — approve or flag critical changes (24hr turn).
- 5/11: Exec go/no-go call (15 min) with Stellar execs and our leadership; decision recorded in HubSpot + signoff email.
- 5/12 EOD: DocuSign routing and Procurement submits PO to Redwood.
- 6/01: Pilot kick-off (soft launch, limited traffic).

Jonas — internal notes for the exec call (short):
- Meters: latency SLOs, 99th percentile under 500ms in our run — show the perf dashboard snapshot.
- Risk: reranking regression — mitigation is to pin the previous model variant with a canary for 48h and a KV cache warmup.

Samantha, I’ll include the canary and fallback details in MAP v3 section 4.2 explicitly. Do you want the go/no-go call at 8:30am PT on 5/11 or 12:00pm PT? I’ll route a calendar invite after we pick a time.

Thanks — I’ll loop Legal in now.

— Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Cc: legal_team@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-09T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: legal review + exec briefing prep (Stellar MAP)

Jonas / Lauren — quick internal thread to confirm our internal signoff steps. I reviewed the SOW redlines from Stellar and highlighted two items for Legal to confirm:
1) Data retention clause: Stellar asks for a 90-day ephemeral cache retention instead of our 180-day default. We can accept 90 days for the pilot only if the contract has a toggle for production.
2) SLA exception language: they requested a credit for partial downtime during the pilot window; Legal recommends a capped credit tied to pilot throughput.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Lauren: 24h legal check on these two points and approval to route DocuSign.
- Jonas: prepare the 10-slide exec readout (perf, risks, MAP timeline) — I’ll draft the mitigation language for the reranking regression.
- If Legal approves, we route the SOW to Stellar on 5/12 09:00 PT with DocuSign link and a PO submission deadline of 5/12 EOD.

Also allocating our Customer Success lead on the 6/01 start to shadow the pilot for the first 72 hours.

Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@stellarsys.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@stellarsys.com>, procurement@stellarsys.com
Date: 2028-05-09T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation readout — need decision window

Thanks for the clear runbook. 8:30am PT on 5/11 works for our execs (Samantha / Tom) — please send a 15-minute invite.

On the two legal asks: procurement is fine with the 90-day pilot retention as long as we can explicitly renew or change to 180 days at production. The credit cap sounds reasonable; we’ll expect the draft proposed by Legal and sign if it is pilot-scoped.

We will prioritize PO routing on 5/12 EOD, but our finance needs the DocuSign packet by 9am PT on 5/12 to follow internal approval meetings (they’re tight on the month-end cut).

I’ll be on the exec call. Sending Tom as backup for procurement/PO details.

— Samantha

- Lauren approved Legal check-in (she greenlit the pilot-scoped retention and the capped credit language this afternoon).
- I updated MAP v3 section 4.2 to explicitly call out the 48h canary, fallback model id, and KV warmup window.
